text: - Context Plane inbox tombstones (0.2.12): an acknowledged delivery receipt acts as a temporary tombstone for the same evidence — enqueue suppresses only a message whose `messageId` and stable content `fingerprint` (sha256 over the validated message, identity excluded) both match an already-acknowledged receipt. Content/revision changes or a new id reappear; `receiptRetentionMs` pruning lets identical evidence be delivered again. Inbox state schema is v2 with transparent v1 migration; migrated receipts carry no fingerprint and never suppress.
